shadow: A single bet could send your life spiralling into a new direction. A simple act of kindness could shatter the world you know all around you.

When Kaz, an orphaned shut-in, manages to discover a new form of magic, he drags his childhood friend, Ryuki, into a journey that neither of them could prepare for. As they discover the family they’ve never had, how far will they have to go to preserve what they’ve gained? When forced to confront the horrors of the world, they quickly must learn what working as a team truly means, or face fates far worse than death.
self: Sometimes family comes from the places you’d least expect.
What would you do to protect that family, even from themselves?

When they realize that eyes have been upon them, Kaz, Ryuki, Nenn, and Zero are forced to look back on their adventure with a new perspective. As new threats and allies make themselves known, will they be able to maintain a grip on themselves, or will they succumb to the darkness within?
